I am an **Associate Professor** in the [Department of Economics](https://fss.um.edu.mo/economics/) at the **University of Macau**.

My research is in **time series and financial econometrics**, with recent work on
testing and monitoring for explosive bubbles, comparing forecasts across
frequencies, spot volatility estimation, and unit-root and cointegration testing
under nonstationary volatility.

I received my PhD in Econometrics from the **University of Amsterdam** and the
**Tinbergen Institute** in 2012. Before joining Macau I held positions at the
**University of Nottingham** and **City, University of London**.

---

### Recent

- [Improved Andrews' formula for testing changing mean](publications/2026-el-andrews.qmd) (with W. Li and X. Zhang) — forthcoming at *Economics Letters*. [code](https://github.com/yang-zu/truncated-andrews-bandwidth){.code-badge}
- [Covariate-augmented CUSUM bubble monitoring procedures](publications/2026-covariate-cusum.qmd) (with S. Astill and R. Taylor) — forthcoming at *Econometric Theory*.
- [Statistical comparison of forecasts made at different frequencies](publications/2026-jbes-frequencies.qmd) (with R. Zhang and W. Li) — forthcoming at *Journal of Business and Economic Statistics*.
- [Testing for an explosive bubble using high-frequency volatility](publications/2025-wp-high-frequency-bubble.qmd) (with H. P. Boswijk and J. Yu) — working paper.
